claims.claim: Perfectly refurbished standing Gas cooker in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show the cooker's appearance but not whether burners or oven function.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: Age and usage history are not shown in the report.
No functional test or fault inspection is shown in the photos.
Internal condition cannot be seen in remote photos.
Receipt and warranty card are not shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Burners or oven may not work.
risks.proof: Video of all four burners lit and oven reaching temperature.

risks.risk: Gas hose, regulator, or cylinder may not be included.
risks.proof: Photo of any gas accessories included with the cooker.
risks.if_unproven: as cooker only, without gas accessories.

risks.risk: Age and usage history are unknown; it may not be barely used or one year old.
Plastic wrapping may only protect a used item, not indicate new condition.
risks.proof: Close-up of the item under the wrapping or proof of purchase.

risks.risk: Oven door seal or interior may be damaged.
risks.proof: Photo or video of the oven interior and door seal.
risks.if_unproven: as seal worn or interior condition unknown.

risks.risk: Delivery within Oyo may not be available.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation of delivery to Oyo.
risks.if_unproven: as buyer arranges collection or pays extra for delivery.

proof_requests: Video of all four burners lit and oven heating.
Photo of gas hose, regulator, and cylinder if included.
Photo of oven interior and door seal.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a 4 burner gas cooker with oven, so a worst-case price can be set despite unverified claims about condition and age.
